purpose.description: RTT Infinity Prompts extends the Prompts module with infinite-resolution scaffolds — structured prompt sequences that recursively drill deeper into each overlay's signal space without losing the structural frame. Each scaffold begins with the full six-overlay session context declaration, then forks into overlay-specific depth levels (surface, intermediate, deep, and structural-root). Infinity prompts are designed for complex diagnostics where standard single-pass prompts are insufficient — multi-domain runs, paradox-heavy systems, and collapsed-coherence recovery diagnostics.
